content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Lab research tools and clinical diagnostic manufacturing sold to labs and hospitals; no physician network or pharma marketing business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Revenue cycle and billing services and practice software sold to providers; does not sell pharma marketing or a physician network."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures generic prescription drugs for pharmaceutical partners; a drug manufacturing business, not a digital platform."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Government biodefense vaccines and antitoxins plus contract drug manufacturing; different products and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Consumer prescription discount and telehealth platform; consumers are the core customer, not physicians or pharma marketing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Hospital workforce credentialing, training and scheduling software; sells to healthcare employers, not physicians or pharma."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Patient experience and employee survey programs sold to hospitals; no clinician network or pharma marketing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Diversified medical, dental and infection products with coding software; product manufacturing differs from Doximity's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Scientific instruments, lab consumables and contract drug manufacturing; a lab equipment and CRO business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Hospital EHR, revenue cycle and hosted software for rural hospitals; hospital IT customers, not physicians or pharma."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Cloud commercial, CRM and data software sold to pharma companies for marketing and trials, overlapping Doximity's life sciences offering."}]}
